en: Now, all these course sections in this
course will follow a certain structure.
We'll always start by diving into the core
problems and the important rules and
concepts you should know to solve these
problems. For example, when we talk about
naming, I will start by explaining how good
names look like and why they look like this.
So we'll learn about bad code and why it's
bad, and we'll understand these core rules
and concepts you should follow.
But theory alone won't do the trick. That's
why in all these course sections, I'll back
that theory up with demos and examples.
We'll see both bad and good code in action
and we'll also transform bad code to good
code together so that we have a realistic
example and we can see that transformation
in action rather than me just throwing
finished examples at you.
In addition, every section will have
challenges for you.
There are challenges where you can apply
what you learned and where I challenge you
to analyze and improve and transform some
dirty code on your own.
This ensures that you don't just learn about
these concepts in theory, but that instead
you get a lot out of this course and you
will really remember these concepts so that
you can use them in your upcoming projects.
